Summary description of proposed program (not to exceed 2 pages) The information age has brought advancements in technology and data collection techniques thatproduce an abundance of accessible data in all sectors. However, much of the ever-increasing data isunstructured and requires parsing for eﬀective decision making. Data Scientists make sense out of complex data or big data. Skills include: developing and applyingmethods to collect, record, store, analyze, and interpret data; eﬀectively extracting useful information;and detecting patterns, trends, and relationships in datasets for decision-making purposes. The data

scientist is often a storyteller presenting data insights to decision makers in a way that isunderstandable and applicable to their interests.
The ﬁeld of Data Science is interdisciplinary at its core, drawing knowledge from computer science,mathematics, statistics, and ethics, all within a framework of the domain area of the data itself.
Itsprimary goal is to gain insights and knowledge from any type of data, both structured andunstructured, and provide important resources to organizations that make data-driven decisions.Data Science is an exciting and dynamic ﬁeld that will continue to grow in importance to business,industry, science, many academic disciplines, healthcare, and government in the years ahead.
DataScientists are employed in all sectors, including ﬁnance, insurance, healthcare, social assistance, retailtrade, and manufacturing, both public and private.
Core expertise requirements for careers in data science are increasingly interdisciplinary and enabledby computational skills, requiring deep integration of data and domain subject knowledge to provideinnovative solutions to problems.

Students are exposed to an array of Data Science approachesenabling them to solve problems individually or as a part of teams.
Master of Science In Data Science Online Program Description Students learn to tackle problems that require core skills from computational, statistical, andmathematical sciences along with some domain area knowledge.
Emphasis is given tointerdisciplinary team building to solve problems that cannot be solved within a given discipline andto the ethical implications of data on individuals and society.
This program prepares data scientists toexcel in machine learning, analysis of large and/or unruly datasets, and visualization through anapproach that hones skills in problem solving and collaborative research.
In addition, studentsanalyze problems using advanced theoretical knowledge and skills of data science in statistics,machine learning theory, and mathematical methods to create innovative solutions to complexproblems in data science across a variety of domain areas.
This is a 10-course, fully online, asynchronous program that is oﬀered in the accelerated calendar ofsix 7-week sessions per year.

It is designed for working adults to take one course at a time, eachsession for 10 sessions.
Students can complete the program in 20 months.

For the Online Graduate Certiﬁcate in DataScience, the admission criteria is that prior courses in calculus, linear algebra, probability andstatistics, and programming in Python are recommended, but not required.

Part 1.
Briefly describe program.

This is an interdisciplinary program in which all colleges and departments are invited to participate.
The program will have a set of core courses from CS, MTH, and STA that can be used in a thesis or non- thesis MS as well as a certificate program.
Using a model similar to that of the graduate programs in CELS, additional classes will be chosen by the student’s committee.
Faculty will be invited to affiliate with the program as eligible major advisors and curriculum committee members.
The curriculum committee will vet requests for affiliations.
The student and major advisor will submit a proposal to the graduate data science program for approval of the thesis topic and courses.
Faculty who are not affiliated with the Data Science Program will be permitted to submit similar proposals.
The Graduate Data Science committee will decide if the thesis topic and planned courses are sufficiently data driven and aligned with the intent of the data science program.
Please find attached a draft of the courses (and tracks) that are currently under consideration.
We have not included a required ethics class in the curriculums.
However, ethics is a required element of any data science program.
